shots.action: Black water in a cave. A boy in a wetsuit and a full-face mask floats face down, asleep; a diver, chest-deep beside him, takes hold of him with both arms and sinks, pulling him under. Rings spread, bubbles come up
shots.camera: At water level, close, pushing in and sinking

shots.action: Two gloved hands lower the full-face mask onto the sleeping boy's face; his eyes stay shut
shots.camera: From above, close, drifting

shots.action: The diver wades out with the masked boy floating beside him and takes him under. The coach watches from the edge, hands clasped, grief on his face; Rook stands by with a wing at his beak, the rest of the team sitting behind
shots.camera: From out on the water, low

shots.action: Under water: the diver swims along the yellow guide line with the limp boy held under his chest, lamp cutting the murk, bubbles rising from both
shots.camera: Ahead of them and to the side, rolling

shots.action: Rook at the water's edge points a wing at the bubbles where they went under, beak open; then turns to us, folds his arms and goes flat-eyed
shots.camera: From the water, pushing in on him

shots.action: Close: water runs off his hat brim. He taps his beak, unimpressed
shots.camera: Close on his face

shots.action: A grey afternoon before the rain. Seven of the team walk up the path past their bicycles at the rail, talking, one laughing; a wheel is still turning. Rook, on the rail, watches them go by with his wings on his hips
shots.camera: Side-on from across the path, tracking with them

shots.action: The cave mouth in the cliff as the rain starts, water running down the path into it; the last three of the team walk into the dark with a torch
shots.camera: Wide and low from beside the bicycles, creeping in

shots.action: From inside: boys in football shirts and their coach walk down into the dark towards us, torches on, smiling, the grey rain behind them
shots.camera: Inside the mouth, looking out, drifting back

shots.action: Brown water pours in over the lip of the cave and down the slope past the lens
shots.camera: Inside, at floor level, looking out

shots.action: The low arch they came in through goes under, the water climbing to its roof; three boys run from it, wide-eyed, mouths open, torches swinging
shots.camera: Low, backing away in front of them

shots.action: The bicycles in the rain at the rail. Rook stands on the rail, arms folded, and turns his head to the cave, flat-eyed
shots.camera: Close and low, sliding along the rail

shots.action: Night. A rescue worker's torch beam sweeps along the bicycles and stops on a lock still on a wheel; he bends to it, eyes wide, and points. A second worker comes up the path behind him
shots.camera: From behind the rail, low, easing in on the lock

shots.action: Five of them wade waist-deep along the passage, foam piling up behind; the coach turns and waves the others on, shouting
shots.camera: From the side, tracking with them

shots.action: A slope of mud rises out of black water. Boys claw up it on hands and knees, the coach pushing from below; Rook hops up beside them, flapping, beak open
shots.camera: Low from the water's edge

shots.action: The whole chamber: thirteen small figures huddled on the mud above the water, two torches between them, the roof hung with stone
shots.camera: Wide from out over the water, rising

shots.action: Dusk and rain at the foot of the mountain: canopies, lamps on poles, a crowd in helmets, workers bent over a map, two carrying air tanks across, pumps shaking. Rook, on a crate, looks it over and puts a wing to his chin
shots.camera: High and wide, swinging round and coming down

shots.action: A flooded tunnel: a diver drags himself along the guide line against the current, silt and bubbles streaming past him
shots.camera: In front of him, low, rolling

shots.action: A row of pumps shudders and puffs, hoses running off into the dark; a worker kneels at one with a tool. Rook walks along the row, stops and taps his beak
shots.camera: Low, three-quarter along the row

shots.action: Rook on a boulder in the flooded passage, the water racing past below him; he shakes the wet off and folds his arms
shots.camera: Three-quarter from across the water

shots.action: The end of a big blue pipe: brown water roars out of it and spreads, foaming, into a rice field
shots.camera: Low beside the outlet, rolling a little

shots.action: From above: the green plots go under one after another as the brown water spreads from the pipe, a wooded ridge behind; a farmer in a straw hat stands on the bank with his hands on his hips
shots.camera: High, swinging round and sinking

shots.action: The farmer on the bank, water over his fields behind him. He turns to us and nods, a small smile. Rook, beside him, tips his hat to him
shots.camera: Three-quarter, pushing in

shots.action: A card: nine marks scratched on wet rock, one after another, a small moon under each
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Over the boys' heads from the top of the slope: the black water below begins to glow. Heads lift. Rook gets to his feet
shots.camera: High behind them, sinking

shots.action: A diver's helmet breaks the surface in a ring of ripples, lamps blazing; a second comes up behind him. He raises a hand
shots.camera: At water level

shots.action: The diver's light falls on the boys: hands up against the glare, then they are on their feet, arms in the air, mouths open
shots.camera: From the water, pushing in

shots.action: Rook walks along the front row counting them off with a wingtip, a number ticking up beside him. He reaches the coach: thirteen. His hat jumps
shots.camera: Tracking with him along the row

shots.action: On the mud: two navy divers and a doctor among the boys, four of them wrapped in silver blankets. One diver kneels and tucks a blanket round a boy, the other holds a torch; the doctor kneels with a hand on a boy's shoulder, the boy looking up at him
shots.camera: From the water, moving in and up

shots.action: Close: a boy's hand with a pencil moves across a pad on his knee by torchlight, line after line
shots.camera: Close over the pad, easing in

shots.action: At the water's edge a boy kneels and holds out an orange pouch; a diver, chest-deep, takes it, turns and sinks away along the line. Rook, arms folded, unfolds one wing and waves him off
shots.camera: Low from the side, over the water

shots.action: At the back of the slope the coach sits apart with a pad on his knees, head bowed, writing slowly; the boys sleep in front of him. Rook, sitting nearby, looks at him, then looks away and lets his hat brim drop
shots.camera: From among the sleeping boys, drifting

shots.action: The diver, chest-deep at the edge, points back the way he came: the guide line runs down into the black water. The coach kneels at the edge, listening, brows drawn
shots.camera: Over the coach's shoulder

shots.action: Under the surface: a rock tunnel full of murky water, the guide line running away into it towards a narrow gap
shots.camera: Moving forward along the line, rolling

shots.action: A card: a drawn cross-section of a mountain. The mouth on the left, thirteen dots on a ledge on the right, and the tunnel between them filling with water
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: A card: the chamber drawn as a pocket in the rock with thirteen dots in it; the band of good air above them thins from the top down
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Under a canopy, workers lean over a map on a table, one tracing a line on it, one pointing, one with a hand at his chin. Rook stands at the end of the table and taps his beak
shots.camera: Over the table, sliding

shots.action: The camp again from the far side, rain coming down harder on the canopies and the crowd; the pumps shake
shots.camera: Low and wide from the other side, drifting

shots.action: A card with three drawings, lit one after another: a rain cloud over a water line, a drill coming down through rock, a small diving mask. The third is struck through
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: A small boy at the water's edge puts one foot in and pulls it straight back, arms wrapped round himself. Beside him Rook lowers a weighted line into the water to sound it
shots.camera: Low from the water

shots.action: A dim passage, ankle-deep. A diver wades along the guide line with an air tank in his arms, his lamp sweeping the wall
shots.camera: In front of him, backing away

shots.action: He kneels and stands the tank beside the guide line, next to three others, then looks back over his shoulder. His lamp slowly dims; water drips from the roof
shots.camera: Moving round and down towards him

shots.action: The row of tanks and the line, nobody there. One small light beside them flickers and goes out; drips ring the still water
shots.camera: Sinking slowly towards the water

shots.action: Rook walks up to the tanks, takes his hat off, holds it to his chest and bows his head; drips ring the water
shots.camera: Circling him slowly, rising

shots.action: The boys on the mud, wide-eyed, all looking down at the water; the coach stands at the edge with his hands clasped. Rook sits among them, hugging his knees, and turns his head to look where they look
shots.camera: High from the side over the water, moving in

shots.action: A diver kneels on the mud beside a boy in a wetsuit sitting on a silver blanket, and opens a small case of vials; the coach kneels on the other side with a hand out to the boy, who looks up at the diver
shots.camera: Low from the water's edge, easing in

shots.action: The boy lies back on the blanket. The diver kneels over him, a hand on his arm, the coach on the other side. The boy's eyes close
shots.camera: Over the diver's shoulder, moving in

shots.action: The gloved hands lower the mask onto his face, seen from the other side
shots.camera: From above and behind, close

shots.action: The diver wades out with the sleeping boy and takes him under, seen from along the bank: the coach and Rook stand at the edge and watch him go
shots.camera: From along the water's edge, higher

shots.action: Under water: the diver with the boy comes along the line towards us; a second diver holds station beside a spare tank on the tunnel floor, lamp on them, and waves them through
shots.camera: From ahead and above, backing off, rolling

shots.action: The diver and the boy from further off and above, small in the tunnel, the lamp a cone in the silt
shots.camera: Higher and further back, rolling

shots.action: The narrow gap, from the far side: light in the slot, then the boy's masked face comes through first, eased ahead by the diver behind him
shots.camera: Low, facing the gap

shots.action: Dusk at the cave mouth under work lights, hoses running into the dark: two rescuers carry a stretcher out with a small shape under a foil blanket. Rook flaps along beside them, eyes warm
shots.camera: Low, backing away in front of them

shots.action: A card: three dates in a row, 8 July, 9 July, 10 July, with four, four and five small figures lighting up under them
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Night in the camp: every arm goes up, workers jumping and shouting under the lamps. Rook's arms unfold and go up too; his hat jumps off his head
shots.camera: Low among them, pushing in

shots.action: A card: thirteen small figures, twelve boys and their coach, ticked off one after another. 13 OF 13
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: A pump by the cave mouth shudders and puffs, then stops dead. Rook, beside it, unfolds his arms and prods it, eyes wide
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter

shots.action: Inside: the water comes back up the passage, over the tanks and the line. A work light on a stand topples, flickers and goes out. Rook flaps up out of the way
shots.camera: High, backing off

shots.action: Four rescue workers wade hard down the passage towards us, waist-deep and rising, torches swinging, mouths open, foam chasing them. Rook flies ahead of them, looking back
shots.camera: High from the side, backing away fast

shots.action: The cave mouth at night under the work lights: the last workers and the navy divers walk out of the dark, one by one raising a fist. Rook flies out over their heads
shots.camera: Low beside the path, easing in

shots.action: A bright hospital ward: four boys in pale gowns sit up in a row of beds and wave, one after another, grinning. Rook, on a bedside locker, unfolds a wing and waves back
shots.camera: From the foot of the ward, moving in

shots.action: The team in their football shirts walk down the ward in a line towards a doorway full of daylight, the coach last. Rook touches his hat brim as they pass
shots.camera: From behind them, following

shots.action: Evening in a temple hall: five boys in orange robes kneel in a row with their hands together and heads bowed, in front of a long table of candles and flowers; the flames shiver
shots.camera: Low from the side, along the row

shots.action: Past the candles: Rook stands at the end of the table, takes his hat off, holds it to his chest and bows his head; the boys kneel beyond him
shots.camera: Close past the candle flames, drifting

shots.action: Morning, the rain gone. Rook stands in front of the cave mouth, turns to us and shrugs, eyes warm
shots.camera: Three-quarter, drifting in

shots.action: The camp from high up: the canopies, the lamps and the crowd, small under the mountain
shots.camera: Higher and further back, swinging round

shots.action: Rook's case board, a slab of wet limestone: a photograph of the thirteen on the ledge, THIRTEEN IN, THIRTEEN OUT, stamped TRUE
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: By the path he picks a small brass torch out of the mud, clicks it on, pockets it and pulls his hat brim down
shots.camera: Three-quarter, pushing in
